name: UI Skills
summary: Curated catalog of 349 installable agent skills for design engineering: accessibility, motion, UI quality and frontend craft.
description: Browse 349 skills that install into AI coding agents via the npx ui-skills CLI or an MCP server, organised by topic (accessibility, motion, UI, performance, testing …) and by problem collections (mobile app design, landing pages, dashboards, forms). The site also hosts a playbook of small UI rules, a Design.md collection from Vercel, Atlassian, Ant Design and others, and curated lists of component and icon libraries.
contains: 349 skills with topic filters (accessibility 33, motion 70, UI 174, performance 34 …)
install via npx ui-skills CLI or MCP server from the same registry
task collections: mobile app design, website layout, landing page, dashboard, forms
Design.md collection with designs from Vercel, Atlassian, Mintlify, Ant Design …
playbook rules: text-balance, tabular-nums, 44px touch targets
